author: Eurogamer
text:
Rockstar Games and GTA co-founder chimes in on the raging physical games debate: "If people want that, companies should provide it"

Rockstar Games co-founder Dan Houser and longtime Rockstar writer Lazlow Jones have chipped in on the physical video games debate.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Shigeru Miyamoto thinks people don't care about console specs that much anymore, believes Nintendo instead provides "gameplay that only we can create"

A new interview with Nintendo's Shigeru Miyamoto has revealed he thinks people don't care about graphics and performance that much anymore, compared to consumer priorities in generations gone by.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Baldur's Gate 3 players on PC can't decide if the latest third-person camera mod is a revelation or a crime against Larian's original vision

The discussion of whether Baldur's Gate 3 needs an actual third-person camera mode or not is ongoing, but with Larian now focused on Divinity, modders keep putting out modifications that try to deliver what many players demand in different ways. Now, a 'true third-person camera' mod has blown up in popularity and reignited the endless debate.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls had a Magik-al open beta weekend, as character popularity data reveals a surprising community favourite

The data is in! Following the weekend open beta for Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls, one player has done the work and discovered which character was the most popular among enthusiastic players.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
User-made maps from Steam top-seller Meccha Chameleon have been found to contain malware, just as the game's official Discord server got hacked

The indie viral mega-hit prop hunt game Meccha Chameleon has had quite the unfortunate weekend. The game's developer has responded to a report claiming some of the game's Steam Workshop maps included malware. Those maps are user-created, and - like all Workshop maps - were available to download by anyone who owns the game.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
As Grand Theft Auto 6 hopefuls grow anxious for a gameplay trailer, AI GTA 6 slop is getting millions of views on social media

As Grand Theft Auto 6 inches towards its November release date and people grow anxious for a proper gameplay trailer, GTA 6 AI slop is raking in millions of views on social media.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Xbox service is down, with outages meaning players can't play any digital or physical games, after similar PlayStation Network issues last week

Xbox's online services are currently down, and it's curious timing, as its rival PlayStation Network had similar issues only last week.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Bethesda yet again reassures fans that The Elder Scrolls 6's roadmap is unaffected by recent Xbox layoffs

Despite recent reports to the contrary, The Elder Scrolls 6 developer Bethesda said that work on the upcoming role-playing game won't be impacted by the 3,200 Xbox layoffs, half of which have already taken place.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
"4 or maybe even 5 instalments" If you want Remakes of older Final Fantasy games, prepare for them to be even bigger than the FF7 Remake trilogy

This weekend, Final Fantasy fans from around the world converged at an exhibition centre in Berlin, celebrating the massive Final Fantasy 14 Fan Fest. It was an interesting celebration; not only was Final Fantasy 14's iconic lead, Naoki 'Yoshi-P' Yoshida, in attendance, but the show also brought Final Fantasy 7 Remake lead Naoki Hamaguchi back to Europe, too.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Resident Evil 4 is by far and away the best-selling remake on this console generation, new analysis reveals

We've known for a while that the 2023 Resident Evil 4 remake has been one of Capcom's best-selling titles, but how does it stack up against all the other remakes released on the current console generation? Pretty well, it turns out.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Is Morrowind the new Doom? After getting a dual-screen port, the fan-favourite Elder Scrolls is now running in browsers

Last week, we reported on a dual-screen port of Morrowind for the AYN Thor handheld. Fans of the third Elder Scrolls aren't stopping there though, as someone has now made Morrowind fully playable in your browser.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Will you power down your PS5 for a week in protest of Sony's all-digital future? A new petition encourages you to pull the plug on PlayStation

The backlash against Sony's proposed all-digital future continues apace this week. The company, which recently announced plans to end all physical media within the PlayStation ecosystem, has faced massive pushback on its plans to kill off the manufacture and sale of discs by 2028, with fan petitions gaining traction and negative comments swamping practically every Sony post on social media.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Final Fantasy 14 comes to Switch 2 later this year with the now-famous free trial, but the file size is going to be absolutely massive

One of this year's most surprising Nintendo Switch 2 port announcements was Final Fantasy 14's back in April, and against all expectations, it was set to arrive in August. Now we know it's right around the corner, and the Evercold expansion has received a big teaser trailer, too.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
A fantastic-looking teaser trailer for a new Myst game has been released, though tragically we'll never get to actually play it

Good news, puzzle lovers! A new teaser for a Myst game has been released online. Bad news, puzzle lovers! You'll never get to play it: the game is cancelled.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Rockstar clarifies which GTA 6 pre-order download codes are going to be region-locked, and how that is going to affect the game in your country

When Grand Theft Auto 6 pre-orders initially went live a little over a month ago, a number of retailers posted conflicting messages about which countries and regions the controversial code-in-the-box download code is actually going to work.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls dev apologises for PC "gameplay and performance issues"

The open beta for Marvel T&omacrkon: Fighting Souls is finally here, and it seems PC players are struggling with a host of issues unique to the PC port, prompting developer Arc System Works to issue an apology and troubleshooting guidelines over the weekend.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
"Sony had the strictest social media guidelines they've ever seen issued," says former first-party dev about physical disc backlash

Sony has reportedly issued its strictest-ever social media guidelines to staff at its first-party studios following the backlash to its physical media announcement.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
The next Kratos God of War game will follow and connect to Laufey, says Cory Barlog

Santa Monica Studio head of creative, Cory Barlog, has confirmed that the next mainline, Kratos-starring God of War will pick up after the events of God of War Laufey.
